release_system.rule: Extend the existing Release Gate; do not create an independent certification path.

service_level_objectives.sli: Successful email-OTP session establishment and authoritative account loading for eligible users.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99.9% successful eligible authentication journeys over 30 days; invalid, expired, suspended, deleting, and deleted accounts fail closed.

alert.condition: Eligible authentication success falls below 99.0% for 15 minutes or inactive-account access succeeds once.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set IDENTITY_AUTH_ENABLED=false for new authenticated product journeys while preserving account identifiers and audit evidence.

service_level_objectives.sli: Idempotent Follow command completion for active accounts and valid targets.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99.9% successful eligible Follow commands over 30 days with p95 command latency below 750 ms.

alert.condition: Follow command error rate exceeds 2% for 15 minutes or duplicate active relationships are detected.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set ENGAGEMENT_ENABLED=false to stop new relationship commands without deleting existing Follows or Passport history.

service_level_objectives.sli: Authenticated chronological Feed responses from active Follow targets.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99.5% successful Feed reads over 30 days with p95 response time below 1.5 seconds.

alert.condition: Feed error rate exceeds 3% for 15 minutes or unpublished activity appears once.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set FEED_ENABLED=false and retain public Activity plus authoritative Follow state for forward repair.

service_level_objectives.sli: Elapsed time from an eligible published Archive event to its Activity projection.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99% of eligible events project within 5 minutes over 30 days; correction and retraction events remain ordered and idempotent.

alert.condition: Oldest eligible unprojected event exceeds 15 minutes or projection consistency fails.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Stop the Activity projector, retain the authoritative Outbox, and rebuild the projection after repair.

service_level_objectives.sli: Native Inbox creation and authenticated read-state commands for eligible notification intents.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99.5% of eligible intents create or update one logical Inbox item within 2 minutes over 30 days.

alert.condition: Inbox projection lag exceeds 10 minutes or duplicate logical Inbox items are detected.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set NOTIFICATION_ENABLED=false for new notification commands while preserving intents, read state, and retraction evidence.

service_level_objectives.owner: Release Engineering and context worker owners
service_level_objectives.sli: Oldest ready message age, retry count, and dead-letter volume for PostgreSQL Outbox and PGMQ-backed workers.
service_level_objectives.objective: Oldest ready message remains below 5 minutes during normal operation and every dead-letter item has an acknowledged incident or replay decision.

alert.condition: Oldest ready message exceeds 15 minutes, dead-letter volume increases unexpectedly, or replay creates a duplicate business result.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Stop consumers, preserve the authoritative Outbox and queue rows, then resume with idempotent replay after repair.

service_level_objectives.sli: Delivery acceptance for eligible, consented, non-suppressed application email.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99% of eligible messages reach a terminal provider state within 10 minutes over 30 days, excluding documented provider-wide incidents.

alert.condition: Terminal delivery latency exceeds 30 minutes, webhook verification fails, or duplicate provider delivery is detected.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_ENABLED=false while keeping native Inbox delivery active and retaining queued delivery evidence.

service_level_objectives.owner: Community Intake and Review and Moderation
service_level_objectives.sli: Eligible contribution command success plus age of submitted and assigned review work.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99.5% successful eligible submission commands over 30 days; review queues remain within the documented SLA or carry an explicit exception.

alert.condition: Submission command error rate exceeds 3% for 15 minutes or the oldest untriaged submission breaches SLA.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set COMMUNITY_INTAKE_ENABLED=false to stop new submissions while preserving immutable revisions, sources, attachments, and review state.

service_level_objectives.sli: Time from completed private attachment upload to clean, infected, or scan_failed classification.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99% of completed uploads receive a terminal scan classification within 15 minutes over 30 days; non-clean evidence remains inaccessible.

alert.condition: Any quarantined attachment becomes readable or oldest unclassified attachment exceeds 30 minutes.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Stop new attachment completion and fail closed on preview or download while retaining quarantine objects and metadata.

service_level_objectives.sli: Validated Change Set provenance chain and accountable publication authorization consistency.
service_level_objectives.objective: Zero broken provenance chains, self-publication successes, unauthorized publication successes, or mutable published history.

alert.condition: Any chain validation, separation-of-duties, or append-only invariant fails.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Stop publication commands, retain the current immutable Release, and use correction, withdrawal, or forward-fix procedures.

service_level_objectives.sli: Elapsed time from an authorized immutable Release to consistent public Web and API projection.
service_level_objectives.objective: At least 99% of authorized Releases become consistently readable within 10 minutes over 30 days with matching release identifiers.

alert.condition: Web and API release identifiers disagree, projection exceeds 20 minutes, or withdrawn data remains publicly readable.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Withdraw or roll back the public pointer without rewriting historical Releases, then rebuild projections from authoritative state.

service_level_objectives.sli: Immediate access block and per-context completion state for confirmed irreversible deletion requests.
service_level_objectives.objective: 100% of confirmed deletions block authenticated access in the confirming transaction; at least 99% of context workflows complete within 24 hours or expose a retryable failed state.

alert.condition: A confirmed deletion account can authenticate, a context failure is hidden, a tombstone replay is missed after restore, or held scope expands unexpectedly.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set PRIVACY_OPERATIONS_ENABLED=false for new requests without reopening blocked accounts, releasing Holds, removing tombstones, or reversing anonymization.

service_level_objectives.sli: Required audit-write success, unified projection lag, rejected payload volume, export access, and integrity verification.
service_level_objectives.objective: 100% persistence for commands designated fail-closed; at least 99% of accepted source facts project within 60 seconds; zero unexplained integrity mismatches.

alert.condition: A required audit write fails open, projection lag exceeds 5 minutes, rejected sensitive payloads increase, or an integrity digest mismatches.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set UNIFIED_AUDIT_ENABLED=false for the read surface only; required source-context audit persistence continues and sensitive commands remain fail closed.

service_level_objectives.owner: Identity and Engagement plus each administration context
service_level_objectives.sli: Authorized administration-shell entry and server-side capability enforcement for every business command.
service_level_objectives.objective: Zero unauthorized command successes, zero browser direct business-table writes, and at least 99.5% successful eligible admin-shell loads over 30 days.

alert.condition: Any unauthorized command succeeds, browser credentials or private dependencies leak, or direct browser business writes are detected.

service_level_objectives.rollback_control: Set ADMIN_SHELL_ENABLED=false while retaining FastAPI deny-by-default authorization and all authoritative business state.

recovery_drills.proves: Immutable release switch, rollback, withdrawal, cache purge surrogate, and deterministic rebuild.
Authoritative PostgreSQL and private attachment restore assumptions plus recovery checks.
Account, Follow, consent, Passport, queue replay, and identity recovery behavior.
Notification relay, delivery, signed webhook, retry, duplicate, and dead-letter behavior.
Production-like API deployment, withdrawal, rollback, and public release consistency.
Production-like Web baseline, withdrawal, rollback, and stale-response checks.
Pinned Supabase, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, PGMQ, migrations, and seed behavior from a clean reset.
Fail-closed command stop, appeal drain to append-only decision, sanction restoration, scoped enforcement, and transactional projections.
Deletion tombstone reapplication after restore, narrow Holds, non-held deletion continuation, and duplicate replay idempotency.
Integrity mismatch detection, append-only mutation denial, encrypted export expiry, and idempotent retention recovery.
